description: The words attached to an athlete's plan: their replies to planned sessions (can't do it, move it, easier, shorter, a question — with a reason and their words, typed or transcribed), notes on a week, and the answers given. Open replies are the ones nobody has acted on; a reply about today or tomorrow is the first thing to read. Each carries the session it is about; an open one also carries `context` (the last session of that sport and its RPE, that sport done of planned this week, a life event on the day, the next session of the sport — the figures the app draws beside the reply) and, for an injury or illness, `suggested_event` to add with add_life_event. Answer with answer_message after changing the plan with the usual tools.

open_only.description: Only replies nobody has answered yet
